description.en: Writes a temporary byte flag (only the low 8 bits of the value are kept). Temporary byte flags are a table of byte values (0 to 255) in the flag data, right after the temporary bit flags; 128 bytes fit before the next table. The number is not checked.

true (also when the flag data is not available).
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Counting visits (not found in script_clean/; invented)
